description: Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: Factory owns generic Jido request bridging; remove ignored ask timeout option and set supported strategy config in pre-start hook from live registered tools, retaining inherited default when no declaration and resetting after removal. No ServerManager browser knowledge or deps edits. Tests to add before implementation: real Factory.cmd strategy runtime directive budget with browser, ordinary defaults, tool register/remove transitions; deterministic real Factory/Jido tool-result continuation using existing HTTP LLM stub if feasible. Branches/paths validated: declared, undeclared, empty, warm reconfiguration, inherited request hooks. Mocking plan: only local LLM HTTP boundary; real Jido and tools. Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: Factory timeout doc and docs/services/agent.md runtime boundary. Decisions: strategy build_config consumes static strategy opts, runtime worker consumes config; use public lifecycle hook and Strategy.State update rather than server mutation or reinitialization.
title: [zaq-5j6] Apply declared tool budgets at the Factory strategy boundary
